title: PingPath game definition
description: One file per game in games/<id>.yaml. Structural rules live here; rules JSON Schema cannot express (CIDR validity, non-public and placeholder ranges, overlaps, report files) are enforced by the pingpath-games validator.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier. Must match the file name.

status.description: Anti-cheat compatibility status. untested: never routed (default for new games). testing: routed with a warning while compatibility tests run. supported: tested, routed. unsupported: never routed.

status_reason.description: Why the game has this status. Required for unsupported.

report.description: Path to the compatibility report, relative to the repository root. Required for supported.

anti_cheat.description: Anti-cheat systems the game uses. Use none when it has none and other (explained in notes) when it is not listed.

ports.description: Destination ports of game traffic. The exit relay only forwards to these ports.

regions.description: Server regions players normally connect to.

notes.description: Free text: data sources, caveats, how ranges were verified.

server_ranges.description: CIDR prefixes of the game servers in this region. Only these are routed through the tunnel.

ping_targets.description: Addresses that answer latency probes for this region, for when game servers drop ICMP.
